description:
The mythical nine-tailed fox, gumiho, also known as Lee Yeon, has just moved into the city. Able to take human form, he cleanses human minds, while creating havoc.

Nam Ji Ah, whose current show features urban myths, will stop at nothing to highlight an unusual, even dangerous subject. She targets Lee Yeon, who seems too good to be true, irresistibly handsome, intelligent, fit: the ideal guest.

Lee Yeon's half-brother is the captivating Lee Rang, reputed to be the most dangerous gumiho among humans. Even though he is half-human himself, he has a deep contempt for all human beings.
